title: Malignant Tabernacle
subtitle: Elemental kill task: Caustics, Hyems and Infernos

notes.title: Only three kinds count
notes.body: Caustics, Hyems and Infernos count for Zahir. Scathisa (it looks like a Synnast), Sirrocco, Tsuric, Theral and Maelstrom do not. There are no Synnasts in here.

notes.title: Match the element
notes.body: Caustics are immune to acid and take 65% from lightning. Hyems are immune to cold and take 65% from fire. Infernos are immune to fire and take 65% from cold.

notes.title: Numbers
notes.body: 6 each of Caustic, Hyem and Inferno, so 18 counting kills per clear. You need 25, so wait for the respawn (set to 60 seconds in the data).

notes.title: Essence crystals
notes.body: Caustics, Hyems and Infernos have a 5% chance to drop an elemental essence crystal. Hand them to Zahir for extra XP.
